description: List the letters sent from the signed-in account, newest first, one page at a time. Each item has orderId, status, service, sheets, chargeCzk, createdAt, orderCode and tracking, never the letter content. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; has_more is false on the last page.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

name: list_letters
title: List your letters
